newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia c/account deficit widens in Sept.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia c/account deficit widens in Sept.

text.p: Australia's seasonally-adjusted current account deficit widened to A$1.690 billion in September from August's deficit of A$1.470 billion (revised from A$1.330 billion), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with a seasonally adjusted deficit of A$1.626 billion in September 1995.
The unadjusted September deficit was A$2.229 billion against A$1.985 billion in August (revised from A$1.849 billion), compared with a deficit of A$1.831 billion in September 1995.
Economists had on average forecast a seasonally adjusted September current account deficit of about A$1.30 billion.
The Bureau said exports fell three percent in September, seasonally adjusted, with rural exports falling seven percent and non-rural exports falling one percent.
